units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:3">Ber. II, 3</cite> <he>קרא וט׳ יחזור למקום שט׳</he> if in reading the Sh’ma one made a mistake, he must go back to the passage in which he made a mistake.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:13">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>בכדי שהדעת טוֹעָה</he> within the limits of a reasonable mistake in counting.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 33b:11">Snh. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ט׳ בדבר שהצדוקין וכ׳</he> if the judge made a mistake in a case in which there is no difference of opinion between the Sadducees and Pharisees.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 6a:4">Ib. 6ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ט׳ בדבר משנה</he> if the judge gave a wrong decision against an explicit law in the Mishnah; <he>ט׳ בשיקול הדעת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00950"><he>דַּעַת</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Taanit 3:8">Taan. III, 8</cite> <he>אבן הטוֹעִים</he>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 28b:4">B. Mets. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אבן טוֹעִין</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="I00193"><he>טוֹעַן</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), v. <cite ref="A00172"><he>אֶבֶן</he></cite>.—
Lev. R. s. 13, beg. אני טָעִיתִי את ההלכה I had forgotten the law in the case.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:1">B. Mets. VI, 1</cite> <he>הִטְעוּ זה את זה</he> they deceived one another, i.e. the agent employed to engage laborers did not act according to instruction, v. next w.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:1">M. Kat. II, 1</cite> <he>הִטְעוּהוּ פועלים</he> hired men disappointed him.
Gen. R. s. 19 end (interpret. hishshiani, Gen. III, 13) הִטְעַנִי he deceived me with false promises; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be led astray, be deceived. Tanḥ. Balak 5 כמו שהטעה ה׳ as he led astray, so was he led astray.—Part. מוּטְעֶה, f. מוּטַעַת, מוּטְעֵית misled, brought about by mistake, under false premises.
units: Yeb. 106ᵃ חליצה מ׳ a ḥălitsah to which the yabam consented in consequence of a deception (a promise not kept); Tosef. ib. XII, 13; Keth. 74ᵃ.—
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 25a:14">R. Hash. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>אתם אפי׳ מוּטָעִין</he> ‘ye’ (shall appoint), even if deceived by witnesses (your decision stands).
<cite ref="Shabbat 101b:4">Sabb. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>מוטעין</he> (mattings fastened, or spread) by mistake; a. e.
